At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role as Senior QC Scientist (BioAssay)

**Are you motivated by the opportunity to help build something from the ground up? Genmab is establishing a QC Laboratory, and we are looking for a Senior QC Scientist for a BioAssay team to play a central role in this work.

This is a unique opportunity to help implement methods, shape key processes, and set the standard for how our QC organization will operate in the years ahead.

You will play a key role in the establishment of the laboratory which includes and is not limited to: Method transfers, Validation of Analytical methods, authoring and reviewing laboratory procedures, and supporting qualification of new analytical instruments.

Collaboration and cross-site training with our analytical development group in Utrecht and analytical SME´s in Copenhagen will also be expected in the beginning

The position is an onsite role in our QC Lab in Ballerup and reports to Associate Director, Head of QC BioAssay

**Once In Operation Daily Tasks Includes

**

• Reviewing release and stability analyzes,

• Supporting and training fellow scientists and lab technicians

• Documenting validation activities of analytical methods for clinical phase I/II and III and authoring SOPs.

**Requirements

**

• Master's degree or PhD in chemistry, biology, pharmacy, biotechnology, or related scientific area.

• At least 6+ years of experience in a Quality Control (QC) or analytical development (AD) laboratory or a PhD degree with 3+ years of working experience.

• Strong understanding of analytical science and its application across clinical development stages.

• Good understanding of validation concepts, risk-based approaches, and regulatory expectations.

• Experience with systems and tools relevant to QC (e.g. LIMS, SAS-Jmp, SoftMaxPro)

• You have experience with ELISA´s and pharmacopeia methods for biologics.

**Why Join Us?

**This is a rare opportunity to shape a laboratory from the ground up. You will be part of a highly motivated and international team, working with cutting-edge science and innovative therapies. If you are energized by challenges, driven by curiosity, and eager to see your impact on both processes and people, we want you on the team.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Build Intelligent Systems That Create Real Impact

Are you motivated by solving complex problems with data and AI?

Do you enjoy transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions?

At VENZO, we’re expanding our Data & AI team and are looking for experienced profiles across mid-to-senior level — from strong hands-on engineers to technical leaders who can shape architecture and guide others.

If you want your work to move beyond experimentation and into real-world implementation, this could be the right place for you.

About VENZO

At VENZO, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change – today, not tomorrow.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

About the Role

You will contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of advanced data and AI systems in cloud-based environments.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Architecting and implementing end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions

• Deploying, monitoring, and optimizing models on cloud platforms

• Translating business requirements into structured technical solutions

• Ensuring solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with best practices

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies within AI and GenAI

For more senior candidates, the role also includes:

• Defining technical direction and architectural standards

• Acting as a primary technical contact for clients

• Leading workstreams and mentoring team members

• Contributing to the evolution of our Data & AI capabilities and service offerings

We value profiles who can combine deep technical execution with sound judgment in real client environments.

Your Background

We are open to different experience levels, provided you bring strong fundamentals and practical experience.

Experience and Education

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience

• 2+ years of experience in data engineering or AI/ML, delivering production-ready solutions

• Hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle — from experimentation to deployment and monitoring

• Experience with generative AI

• For senior profiles: experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring others

Technical Capabilities

You have experience working within modern data and AI ecosystems, including:

• Programming: Python and SQL, Typescript is a plus

• Cloud: Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure ML, Data Factory) or other cloud plattforms

• Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow)

• Machine Learning: Classical ML techniques and generative AI applications

• GenAI Tooling: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, frameworks such as LangChain or Microsoft Agent Framework

• MLOps: CI/CD, model lifecycle management, orchestration tools, version control

• Data Engineering: ETL processes and large-scale data processing

How You Work

• Analytical and structured in your problem-solving approach

• Comfortable operating in client-facing environments

• Able to communicate complex technical topics in business-relevant terms

• Pragmatic, quality-driven, and accountable for outcomes

What You Can Expect From Us

• Meaningful, technically challenging projects with real business visibility

• A strong professional environment with high standards and high trust

• Autonomy in how you structure and deliver your work

• Access to modern tooling, platforms, and certifications (including Microsoft)

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Continuous development — technically and professionally

Let’s Talk

Send your CV or a short introduction to hr@venzo.com.

We’re happy to meet for a coffee and explore whether there’s a mutual fit.

We’re looking for a data platform lead with a commercial mindset, ready to help our clients find out where AI fits and to play a central role in growing their business around it.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you’ll advise clients on their data platform and AI choices, design the architectures, build them yourself, and lead the teams that deliver them. It’s a role that’s equal parts business-facing and technical: you’ll design and build on Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric, and be just as at home in the client meeting.

Beyond the client work, you’ll team up with colleagues across The Tech Collective and Implement to spot opportunities, shape scopes, and help win the work. Having built these platforms makes you credible when you sell them, and selling them keeps you building what clients need. As the team grows, you’ll also help shape the offering itself: reference architectures, propositions, and people.

What You’ll Bring

You’re a builder at heart. You have experience designing and delivering data platforms in at least one of Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and you can weigh them against each other. To be a great fit, it helps if you have:

• A commercial mindset – you spot opportunities, shape scopes, contribute to proposals, and are comfortable in a room with senior business stakeholders

• Fluency in AI and how it depends on the data platform – from data foundations and governance to taking AI use cases into production

• Experience leading projects or engineering teams (e.g., as an engineering manager or tech lead) while staying close to the code

• Clear communication with both engineers and executives, and the ability to turn platform choices into business decisions

• A collaborative style – you develop the people around you and enjoy building something together with others

What We Offer

At The Tech Collective, you’ll be part of a team that blends nerdiness, energy, and a sincere interest in people. You’ll have influence over how we grow, close sparring with experienced peers, and the chance to shape the offering as it develops.

Our culture is built on high autonomy with responsibility, co-creation, and active knowledge-sharing. You’ll work on projects across industries and disciplines – from strategy rooms to solution pilots with leading technologies. And to support your growth, we also provide internal training, keynotes, and hands-on learning across AI, data, cyber, and digital strategy.

How To Apply

• We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application ASAP

• Please apply with your CV, cover letter, and university transcripts

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI, and analytics, ensuring that they are ready for what comes next.

Ready to shape the digital future with us?

**_Help customers turn technology into solutions they use every day.

_**At Trackunit, our IrisX industry cloud platform unlocks insights, benchmarks, and innovation through connected construction data. As a Solution Delivery Engineer, you’ll help customers successfully implement and adopt Manager and IrisX, making these platforms part of their everyday operations.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer engagement. You’ll configure solutions, build integrations, and work with customer teams to translate their needs into practical results. Along the way, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across Trackunit and explore a wide range of technologies and customer environments.

****What’s in it for you

******A broad technical playground

**You’ll work across platform configuration, software development, integrations, and data engineering. Depending on the project, you could use Python and SQL, JavaScript or TypeScript, REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and Databricks. There’s room to apply your strengths while building experience in new areas.

**Customer projects with tangible outcomes

**Your work will help construction companies connect their systems, improve their data, and adopt new ways of working. You’ll see solutions through to practical use and understand how your contribution helps customers get more value from Trackunit.

**Collaboration across disciplines

**You’ll work closely with Solution Delivery colleagues, Sales Engineering, IoT Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. You’ll have opportunities to learn from different specialisms, share your knowledge, and contribute customer insights that help improve our platforms.

**Ownership and professional growth

**You’ll take responsibility for meaningful parts of customer delivery, with scope reflecting your experience and strengths. Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, develop your customer-facing skills, or take on more complex implementations, you’ll have opportunities to grow through practical work, coaching, and feedback.

**The Opportunity To Shape How We Deliver

**Beyond individual projects, you’ll help develop reusable solutions, implementation patterns, and documentation. Your ideas and experience will contribute to making future deliveries more effective across the global Solution Delivery team.

**An international and flexible workplace

**You’ll join a global team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal development, with a flexible working setup and connections across teams and borders.

****What you’ll work on

******Solution implementation and adoption

**Configure, extend, test, and deploy Manager and IrisX solutions to fit customer workflows and help customers put them into use.

**Integrations and data pipelines

**Connect Trackunit with customer systems such as ERP, CRM, and fleet management tools through APIs, webhooks, and data flows, supporting reliable and secure data exchange.

**Applied data and analytics

**Turn connected construction data into useful insights, supporting use cases such as equipment fault analysis, benchmarking, and emissions reporting, and other customer-specific analytics use cases.

**Customer enablement

**Work with customer teams through technical workshops, training, and implementation support, helping them confidently operate and adopt the solutions delivered.

**Coordinated delivery and continuous improvement

**Collaborate with internal teams and customer stakeholders on implementation activities and clear handovers. Share delivery learnings and customer feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the platform and future deployments.

**Bring your curiosity and perspective

**There are different paths into Solution Delivery. Your experience might come from software engineering, data, integrations, technical consulting, or practical projects that you’re ready to build on.

You don’t need to know every technology we use. We’re interested in how you approach problems, collaborate with others, and connect technical work with customer needs.

If you enjoy building solutions and helping people put them to work, we’d love to hear from you.

**Our hiring process

**Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Virtual second interview / in-person with the hiring manager and the team.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a peer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

**Overview

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.

Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.

Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.

We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.

The Role

We’re looking for a GTM Engineer to help build the systems behind a smarter, more scalable go-to-market engine at Corti. You’ll connect the tools and data that power our commercial teams, turning fragmented systems into a reliable foundation for automation, insight, and action.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, data, and business impact. You’ll partner closely with Growth, Sales, DevEx Growth, and Platform to design workflows, improve data quality, and build the internal products and automations that help us move faster as we scale.

What you'll do

Data foundation

• Build and maintain the integrated data layer across Corti’s commercial data systems, bringing together data from tools such as Stripe, Attio, Supabase, Calendly, and Leexi.

• Own the event tracking layer, instrumenting key product and commercial touchpoints so analytics tools (PostHog, Mixpanel, etc.) reflect what's actually happening.

• Build enrichment pipelines that pull from third-party data providers and internal signals to keep ICP records current and scored.

Systems and automation

• Design and implement workflows, automations, and backend services that improve how commercial teams operate, from pipeline management and deal acceleration to post-sale handoffs.

• Identify repetitive GTM processes and systematically eliminate them through automation, freeing commercial teams to focus on higher-judgment work.

Activation and tooling

• Build systems that surface timely signals and enable proactive, data-driven GTM execution, including AI-powered internal tools and agentic workflows where appropriate.

• Build internal tools that reduce manual work for sales, CS, and growth, such as automated account research, meeting prep summaries, or usage-based alert systems.

• Partner with Growth and RevOps to define the data models and pipeline logic that underpin campaign targeting, segmentation, and attribution.

Cross-functional impact

• Collaborate as the primary technical builder for GTM teams across Growth, Enterprise Sales, Developer Experience, and Scaled Customer Experience, translating process needs into robust, scalable solutions.

• Document all built components so systems remain understandable and extensible as the team scales.

• Contribute to engineering quality through clean implementation, thoughtful code review, and cross-functional collaboration.

What you bring

• Experience as a software engineer, ideally at mid-level, with exposure to growth, sales, or other go-to-market teams.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript, with a backend or server-side engineering focus.

• Experience integrating business-critical tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar systems.

• Familiarity with analytics and data tooling such as PostHog, Mixpanel, Segment, Google Analytics, Amplitude, or Google Tag Manager.

• Experience working with ETL processes, data synchronization, or workflow automation is a plus, but not required.

• Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, including all-remote communication.

Life at Corti

• You will be reporting to VP of Growth

• The position is full-time and starts as soon as possible.

• Hybrid working environment in Copenhagen

• Equipment provided by Corti

**Ready to dive into the world of Corti? Apply today, and let's start working together on reshaping the dialogue in healthcare, making a real difference for millions of patient outcomes around the world.

**_🤝 Bringing in top talent from all backgrounds is crucial in our pursuit to improve the world of healthcare. We encourage applications from all people and do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, and/or disability status._At Corti, experience comes in many forms, and we’re passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we’re looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you’ll consider applying!

Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**How We Work

**We hire people who are expert at what they do. Once you join, you have the autonomy to shape how you work and the space to do it well. That doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll have colleagues who know their craft, regular collaboration across functions, and easy access to senior leadership when you need it.

We keep our structure flat. We work at pace in an agile, nimble environment where good ideas don’t wait for permission. If you spot something that could work better, we encourage you to say so. If you want to run with an idea, we’ll back you to do it.

We work with people who take pride in their output, back their team through the hard parts, and leave things better than they found them.

**What Happens Next

**Once you apply, our Talent team will review your application. If there’s a fit, they’ll be in touch to discuss the role and next steps.

**How We Use AI In Our Hiring

**We use AI responsibly, both in the software we build for governance teams and in how we hire. Our Talent team may use AI to support application review, CV analysis, or identifying areas that need further verification.

But hiring decisions are made by people. AI surfaces signals; people make the call on whether to progress a candidate or extend an offer.

If you’d like details on how your data is handled during recruitment, contact our Talent team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

**We’re an equal opportunities employer. We’re building a team that works because it reflects a breadth of experience, background, and perspective.

Apply even if you don’t tick every box on the job specification. If the role excites you and you think you could make an impact, we want to hear from you.

We don’t discriminate on the basis of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of recruitment, or if there’s anything else we can do to make the process more accessible, tell our Talent team. We’ll sort it.

**Your Safety Matters

**Be cautious of unexpected messages claiming to be from Board Intelligence. We will never ask you for fees as part of recruitment. If you’re unsure whether a communication is genuine, contact our Talent team through our official channels before sharing information or clicking links.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant for Software Development at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Student Assistant for Software Development at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you're energised by software development and thrive on solving real business challenges through technology, we'd love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a student software developer to join our system development team in Global IT.

As a team, we support NNE's engineering project portfolios and build modern applications that help colleagues work smarter across projects and locations.

As a student software developer, you will play an important role in supporting the team's development efforts by contributing to real business-critical solutions, helping maintain high quality through testing, and bringing fresh perspectives on emerging technologies such as Azure and AI.

This is a part-time position of around 2–3 days a week. You will work on real tasks from day one, with a dedicated colleague to guide you, review your code and help you grow.

How you might spend your days

As a student software developer, you’ll be:

• Developing new features and fixing bugs in our applications, APIs and services

• Building front-end components and backend endpoints under guidance from experienced developers

• Helping perform testing of our applications, running test cases, reporting defects and writing automated tests to keep our quality high

• Taking part in our agile ways of working, stand-ups, sprint planning and code reviews

• Exploring new tools and technologies, such as cloud services on Microsoft Azure and AI and sharing what you learn with the team

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A self-learner who picks up new technologies and tools on your own initiative and is not afraid to ask questions when you get stuck

• Structured and responsible, taking ownership of your tasks and delivering what you commit to

• Collaborative and comfortable working with colleagues across disciplines, locations and cultures

• Curious and proactive in suggesting improvements to tools, processes and technical solutions

• Open to feedback and ready to learn from mistakes, with high spirits and a sense of humour

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field

• Have a basic understanding of programming in C#/.NET or Python

• Have some experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and ideally a modern framework such as React

• Know the basics of relational databases and SQL

• Have used Git for version control

• Communicate well in English, written and spoken

It’s a bonus if you have tried automated testing, CI/CD or cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 15 November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Ivanna Jurkiv Ditlevsen at +45 3077 4721.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Data Scientist - Commercial Data Products (Optimization & Pre-Call Intelligence)
jobs.description:
You will drive the development of commercial data products for enterprise CDP teams, leveraging AI-enabled engineering excellence and cloud-based innovation labs (Snowflake). In this hybrid role based in Copenhagen, you will use Dataiku, Snowflake, and Power BI to optimize core commercial operations and pre-call intelligence. You will collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver scalable solutions that improve productivity and quality while reducing long-term costs. This position anchors you in a managed delivery and optimization program, combining technical depth and cross-team partnership.

**Responsibilities

**

• Design, build, and validate ML models for Commercial Optimization and Pre-Call Intelligence use cases

• Consume features from the Feature Store (Dataiku/Snowflake); flag gaps back to Data Engineering

• Perform exploratory data analysis, feature selection, and model experimentation in Dataiku

• Train, tune, and evaluate models

• Deploy and monitor models in production via Dataiku

• Translate model outputs into business-ready insights with product and commercial stakeholders

• Collaborate with Data Engineering, product, and delivery teams

**Requirements

**

• At least 5 years experience as a Data Scientist in a Commercial Enterprise context

• Hands-on ML model building and deployment in Dataiku (or similar)

• Strong Python and SQL

At Siteimprove, we are the leader in agentic content intelligence. Siteimprove.ai is a unified platform that brings together accessibility, analytics, SEO/AEO, and content strategy into a single, continuous flow. Our AI agents work alongside marketing and digital teams — not instead of them — helping to create high-performing, accessible content that's easy to discover by both humans and AI.

As Senior Engineering Manager for Content Platform, you own the systems that acquire and ingest the content our entire product line reasons about. Our enterprise customers bring thousands of sites each, re-crawled continuously. Every accessibility finding, analytics number, and SEO recommendation begins as content one of your systems fetched, parsed, and stored.

You will lead two Copenhagen engineering teams, each with its own Technical Leader role held by a Principal Engineer. The two carry different hard problems. One sustains crawl throughput so that cost tracks value rather than volume. The other builds the shared foundations the rest of Siteimprove works through, so product lines reach content through common contracts rather than each solving it their own way. You represent this group's engineering in a trio with Product and UX. Pillar strategy is set with Seattle, nine hours behind you, and you are the leader on the ground who turns it into local decisions rather than waiting on it.

Your teams set the ceiling on what the rest of Siteimprove can build. Your goals follow from that — ingestion reliable enough that customers trust it, efficient enough that cost tracks value rather than volume, capable enough to feed our agentic products, and ready for the compliance bar our public sector customers require. You will use AI to build the platform that powers our AI products and stay close enough to the code to argue a design on its merits.

What we will be doing

• Decision Authority in Copenhagen: You are the decision-maker on the ground. Resolve in Copenhagen hours what would otherwise wait overnight. As engineering's voice in the group's trio, bring the constraints Product and UX have no way to see into scope conversations early enough to change them. Your director sets goals with you and discusses how you and the group are tracking against them.

• Platform Ownership: Own Content Platform's ingestion surface as a running business — availability, throughput, cost, and delivery predictability. Modernization is how you improve those numbers, not a separate program you report on. Our move to EKS is part of it. You decide which debt gets paid down and when and keep that trade-off in front of the trio.

• Architectural Direction: Own the constraints and the cross-team contracts your Technical Leaders design within: scheduling the crawl workload so cost tracks value rather than volume, moving ingestion onto event-driven services, and defining how the rest of Siteimprove consumes what we ingest. You will hold that direction with your senior engineers, because authority here is earned in design review.

• Delivery Under Pressure: Hold the delivery line when priorities move. Work arrives from outside the team continuously, and you will sequence so committed work reaches completion rather than stalling half-built. Align directly with peer engineering leaders and close the gaps at functions you depend on but don't manage.

• Measurable Impact: Define the KPIs these systems are judged by and hold your teams to them. You will prove the impact of what you prioritize in throughput, cost, and reliability rather than asserting it, and you will stop work that moves none of them.

• Growing Your Engineers: Own performance, career development, and compensation decisions for the group. Hand the Tech Vision and System Design for major initiatives to the engineers closest to the systems, and review rather than drive them.

• AI-Native Delivery: Use AI for engineering throughput, not just for product features. You will model the practice yourself: interpreting legacy code paths nobody documented, generating test coverage around behavior before you change it, and shortening the distance between a design decision and a working replacement

DevOps / Platform Engineer — Fully Remote, Performance & Production Ownership

Want to work fully remotely with real freedom and ownership while operating high-throughput, low-latency systems that serve billions of shoppers?

For the right person, this is a high-trust role where you have flexibility in how you structure your work and the opportunity to make a significant impact on the technology behind billions of e-commerce experiences.

We’re building the infrastructure behind better e-commerce experiences for billions of shoppers every year.

Our systems serve more than 2,000 requests per second. Our in-house search engine delivers a p50 latency of sub-ms, while our entire infrastructure maintains 99.998% uptime.

We work with modern technology, use AI as a fundamental part of how we build, and continuously push the limits of reliability, performance, and innovation. Our goal is simple: connect e-commerce shoppers with the right products at the right time while helping merchants create a better customer experience and improve their bottom line.

We’re proud of the systems we’ve built—and we want someone who is excited to help make them even faster, more reliable, and more capable.

This job will be perfect for you if

• You enjoy operating high-throughput production systems where latency, reliability, and customer impact matter

• You care deeply about reliability, latency, throughput, and system performance

• You can investigate problems across infrastructure, application code, databases, queues, and networks

• You are comfortable reading, writing, debugging, and optimising production code

• You proactively identify failure scenarios before they become incidents

• You build automation and tooling instead of accepting repetitive manual work

• You enjoy improving CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and developer experience

• You have handled serious production incidents and understand the responsibility that comes with on-call

• You think beyond whether a deployment succeeded and care about how the system behaves afterwards

• You can communicate clearly during incidents and take ownership when things matter

• You are curious about new technology and enjoy finding better ways to build and operate systems

• You want to work closely with software engineers rather than treating infrastructure as a separate world

• You thrive in a remote environment where freedom is matched by responsibility

A normal day for you

No two days will be the same, but your work might include:

• Investigating why a service, query, or piece of application code is slower than it should be

• Improving the reliability and performance of systems serving thousands of requests per second

• Reviewing metrics, traces, logs, and alerts to identify issues before they affect customers

• Designing and implementing infrastructure, automation, and internal tooling

• Writing, reviewing, debugging, and optimising production code

• Working with developers to improve how systems are built, deployed, and operated

• Responding to incidents when needed, then making sure the underlying problem is permanently addressed

• Exploring how new technologies and AI-powered tools can improve our engineering workflow

• Thinking proactively about scaling, capacity, resilience, and potential failure scenarios

AI is part of the job

We’re an AI-first company. AI and agentic coding are already part of how we build, investigate, automate, and improve systems.

You should already be comfortable using AI in your daily engineering workflow—for example, to investigate incidents, generate and review code, build internal tooling, automate operational work, and improve your own productivity.

How we work

This role can be fully remote for the right person.

We believe in giving people the freedom to structure their work in a way that helps them perform at their best. We care about impact, ownership, communication, and results—not about watching when or where you work.

You’ll need to work with meaningful overlap during CET working hours and participate in our PagerDuty/on-call rotation. Freedom comes with responsibility, especially when you are responsible for production systems.

On-call includes holidays

If you are scheduled to be on call and a genuine production alarm goes off—whether that is on a normal weekday, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year’s Eve, or New Year’s Day—you are expected to respond, take ownership, and stay with the issue until our systems are fully up and running again.

This is an important part of the role and is not optional. We are looking for someone who genuinely stands behind their work and understands that production ownership sometimes means being there when things go wrong.

At the same time, your goal is to make this situation as rare as possible. The best engineer is not the person who enjoys firefighting every holiday, but the person who builds reliable systems, strong monitoring, and effective automation so that firefighting is never needed.

How to apply

Instead of starting with a traditional cover letter, please send us a maximum 10-minute video.

We are hiring a human being—not AI-generated slop, a spotless resume, or someone who simply knows how to present the right keywords. We know the kind of person we are looking for, but the process also needs to be mutual. You should get the opportunity to meet the people behind the company and decide whether this is the right environment for you.

That is why we want to meet you upfront and see how you think, communicate, and explain your experience—not only evaluate what is written on paper.

**In The Video, Please Tell Us

**

• Who you are

• The production systems you have owned

• A difficult reliability or performance problem you solved

• What you changed and the measurable result

• How you approach incidents and on-call responsibility

• How you currently use AI and agentic coding

• Why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role

• What you are looking for in your next team and role

The video does not need to be polished. Please don’t spend time producing a perfect presentation or reading a script. We want to see the real person, understand how you think, and hear about the work you have actually done.

You may also include a short written example of a system that was slow, unreliable, or difficult to operate. Explain how you found the root cause, what you changed, and what improved afterwards.

If you are primarily an infrastructure administrator, this probably isn’t the right role. If you are a production-minded software engineer who enjoys making systems faster, more reliable, and easier to operate, we would love to hear from you.

Blue Water Shipping is looking for a dedicated Port Agent to join our Cruise & Port Agency team in Greve. As a Port Agent, you will become part of our 24/7 duty setup, acting as the link between our customers, vessels, ports, authorities, suppliers and other stakeholders. Flexibility is important part of the position, and it requires working outside normal office hours in connection with vessel operations, including early mornings, evenings, nights and weekends.

**About The Role

**As part of the team, you will be involved in planning, coordinating and following vessel calls from the initial preparations until the vessel has departed again. The role combines office-based planning and administration with hands-on operational work at vessels and terminals. You will work with a broad variety of vessels, including cruise ships, cargo vessels and navy vessels calling at Danish ports. The role is primarily based in Greve, but occasional work in Copenhagen is required, as Copenhagen is a major part of the daily operation.

Following your training and as your experience develops, you will take responsibility for coordinating your own vessel calls and daily operations, always with experienced colleagues and managers available for support and sparring. You will act as the customer’s local representative and help ensure that each port call is handled safely, professionally and according to the agreed operational plan.

**Your primary responsibilities will include:

**

• Coordination and handling of vessel port calls

• Planning and coordination of daily port operations

• Daily communication with vessels, customers, ports, authorities and suppliers

• Attendance of vessels and operations at the pier when required

• Handling vessel clearances and relevant documentation

• Coordination of crew changes, transportation and other crew-related services

• Arranging services, supplies, spare parts and other vessel requirements

• Customer invoicing and administrative follow-up

• Handling changing operational requirements and finding solutions when plans change

• Supporting port calls in other Danish ports when required

**Who Are You

**Previous experience in ship agency, shipping or a similar operational role is an advantage, but not a requirement. We are also open to candidates with transferable experience from other service-oriented or operational environments. Most importantly, you are reliable, service-minded, proactive and motivated to learn.

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership and follows tasks through

• Is proactive, solution-oriented and adaptable

• Remains calm and structured under pressure

• Communicates confidently and professionally with different stakeholders

• Works well both independently and as part of a team

• Enjoys a fast-paced, international environment

• Has an interest in shipping, port operations and the maritime industry

You should have strong written and spoken English skills, be comfortable with MS Office and new IT systems, hold a valid Category B driving licence, and be able to travel within Denmark and occasionally abroad.

**What We Offer

**At Blue Water Shipping, you will become part of an informal working environment with experienced colleagues and a strong focus on cooperation, responsibility and professional development.

You will have the opportunity to learn the port agency profession through hands-on experience and daily sparring with colleagues and managers.

We offer:

• A varied working day with responsibility and operational challenges

• Hands-on experience within the international shipping and cruise industries

• Training and continuous professional development

• The opportunity to gradually take responsibility for your own vessel calls and customers

• Close cooperation with experienced colleagues across Blue Water Shipping

• Exposure to international customers, vessels, ports and maritime professionals

• A strong community where cooperation, commitment and team spirit are important

**Contact

**If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Pernille Marcussen, Manager, Cruise & Port Agency, at +45 42124613 or pmar@bws.dk.

Apply as soon as possible, as we review and interview on an ongoing basis.

Our value foundation is still thriving today, driven by a pronounced entrepreneurial spirit and sound business practices. Therefore, our employees are offered a strong professional environment with great freedom, ensuring our customers the best service.
